description: This file defines API endpoints for a sports live-streaming platform backend. It handles routes related to matches and events, including fetching match lists, details, highlights, upcoming matches, and associated event data. It uses FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy for database interactions and provides response models for client consumption.

methods.name: get_matches( page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), status: Optional[MatchStatus] = Query(None, description="Filter by match status"), sport: Optional[SportType] = Query(None, description="Filter by sport type"), user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(optional_auth), db_session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of matches with optional status and sport type filters.

methods.name: get_live_matches( user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(optional_auth), db_session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves all matches currently in progress.

methods.description: Provides detailed information about a particular match by ID.

methods.description: Returns highlights for a specific match with pagination.

methods.description: Fetches upcoming scheduled matches within a specified number of days.
